within 12 months of this policy taking effect. Accountable official(s) are to maintain a
register of accountable use case owners.

traces.matched_text:
Agencies must implement mandatory training for all staff on responsible AI use within
12 months of this policy taking effect. Agencies should consider the Guidance for staff
training on AI and can use the AI fundamentals training module to meet the requirement.
They can use the module as provided, modify it, or incorporate it into an existing training
program based on their specific context and requirements. Alternatively, agencies can
allow their staff to access the module directly through APSLearn.
